- Blog `what-is-a-vps`: add 5-8 in-body links to related VPS-cluster posts (grep for real slugs first).

`worker/analytics.ts` `visitorRollupSweep` populates `VisitorDaily` but `bounces` is 0 in every row. Read the sweep, compute `bounces` = count of that day's sessions with exactly one pageview, matching the existing aggregation style.

Run `npx tsc --noEmit`, fix errors, delete all temp scripts. Report exactly what you changed per item and any slug you couldn't find. Do NOT deploy — the main session reviews and deploys. You MUST actually use tools and do the work; if you hit an error, retry and push through rather than returning empty.
